description: Oil and Gas Ministry of Transportation and Infrastructure Applications is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by British Columbia Energy Regulator. The area of Crown land disturbance for applications falling within a Ministry of Transportation and Infrastructure (MOTI) road allowance. The BC Energy Regulator issues cutting permits for any new Crown land disturbance within MOTI unconstructed road allowances. The Regulator does not issue land tenure over MOTI right of ways. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher British Columbia Energy Regulator. Its tags are Applications, BC Energy Regulator, BCER, Energy Regulator, MOTI. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
